remainingIssues: KNOWN MISS 1 (todo, threshold not weakened): fallback tune M2 = 38/80 = 47.5% vs 60%. Caused by MAX_TIMELINE=30 in src/ai/fallback.js. The later live-eval tuning task owns the fix and MUST remove the todo option on the test named 'M2 pooled timeline recall >= 0.6' in test/eval/fallback-tune.test.js so it becomes a hard assertion.
